notes.title: NEW GAME: StrangerZ Coming in 2023 - FREE TO PLAY & MULTIPLAYER
notes.content:
A new game is coming to the STRANGER series! StrangerZ, it will feature completely redesigned gameplay mechanics from the last game "STRANGER", including: progression/leveling up, multiplayer, more maps, better graphics using next gen technology, competitive ranking system with pvp.

Short description of StrangerZ:
StrangerZ is a Free to Play Multiplayer Survival Horror game. Play as or survive against the "Stranger" with your teammates until dawn. Level up your stats and rank by either surviving or killing all players.

notes.title: SafeZoneVR Series Continues... "STRANGER" coming this July
notes.content:
STRANGER is a upcoming Steam Game as a follow up for SafeZoneVR. 

After taking what I have learned over the past years of game development I have focused all my time on creating a follow up and full repayable enjoyable experience for both PC players and VR players.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
[b]Try the Free to Play Demo for STRANGER and Wishlist here: [/b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1902150/STRANGER/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1902150/STRANGER/[/url]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40919912/35b93e024fce02cc4569ed303fdef3ec59a1ea3c.png[/img]

What is STRANGER?
Protect yourself against a STRANGER trying to break into your house, use the limited locks and look and listen where the intruder is coming from. Lock the windows, reset the power, stay focused. Survive until 6am and begin to unravel the mystery behind your sudden and mysterious STRANGER

-------------
STRANGER is a PC First Person Thriller horror game with VR support developed by the indie developer and maker of SafeZoneVR.
You will be defending your house against a STRANGER. Make use of the 2 provided locks and find the 1 Perma-Lock, lock the windows when you hear/see the STRANGER out the windows. Make it to 6 am when the police arrive to find yourself uncovering the mystery that lies behind this STRANGER.

Some things are subject to change before the Early Access release!

You can choose different levels of difficulty and choose from different maps and uncover the story of your player, the STRANGER, and more. Hidden stories and lore-driven cryptic messages will be left to be discovered.

Immersive Experience: Realistic graphics and spatial audio will have you on your toes and your computer running well with the new UNREAL ENGINE 5 next-gen engine and RTX capability, giving you peak quality with little performance risk.
NonLinear Gameplay: The same thing will never happen twice, replay-ability and new events and an intelligent enemy will give you weeks of gameplay
Deep Story: For lore enthusiasts and mystery enthusiasts you will have to dig deep with the given information to help unravel the mystery behind the unknown STRANGER, hidden items, rare events (easter eggs), photos/trailers/audio cryptic messages to be discovered and much more. (Join the discord community to work together: https://discord.gg/73eeU6pr7b
Much More COMING SOON! Stay tuned as new features will be implemented/experimented with before the early access launch! You can also track development progress and see the roadmap here: https://trello.com/b/NxQjQOoR

notes.title: Nominate SafeZoneVR for VR GAME OF YEAR
notes.content:
Hey SafeZoners!

I come today to say thank you for all of the support with my game SafeZoneVR, it means so much to have such a fanbase around my work and my passion and my [i]dream[/i]. To see all the positive reviews and constructive criticism and meeting all of you in my community discord has motivated me to pursue game development as a career! (I am a high school student dev!)

[b]Help my dreams come true by nominating SafeZoneVR for VR GAME OF YEAR! [/b]

It would truly make my last three years of work BEYOND worth it to see my game even among the top 10 next to triple-A studios with millions of dollars of funding behind them.

Thanks so much! SafeZone on!

notes.title: SafeZone Founder DLC Available Now!
notes.content:
The SafeZone Founder DLC is now available for $5.99, this is a way to donate to me (Will Codes), the developer of SafeZoneVR and help fund my work and make it possible to continue my dream. I released the game for free and promised to never charge any money for this game from the start. No content is included in this DLC to follow that vow. When purchasing this DLC you become a SafeZone franchise founder by helping me be able to continue to work on updates and future games (: 
I put 3 years of work and endless nights into SafeZoneVR and out of pocket money to create the game free to play on steam. It is my dream to pursue game development and make it a stable way of living. 

[b]LINK TO DLC: [/b] https://store.steampowered.com/app/1733210/SafeZone_Founder_DLC/
Also, stayed tuned to Will Codes on [url=https://youtube.com/willcodes][b]YouTube[/b][/url], something is brewing in the SafeZone (:

notes.title: Game Release Delay
notes.content:
SafeZoneVR will now be releasing on August 27 instead of August 20. So sorry about the inconvenience.
The reason for this is ironing out certain bugs that Steams reviewers found when testing my game. I have been hard at work EVERY SINGLE day and night on this game for the last 4 weeks. I am sorry about the delay and tried to prevent it. 
- Will Codes

(The game will [i]probably[/i] also be releasing with only Oculus sdk headset support for the initial release. I had the other headsets included and coded in but can't test them without the valve index for example, when reviewed by steam I was informed they were not working. Sorry for the inconvenience, expect an update with wider headset support soon after release.
